name: Pain Tolerance
text: **Pain Tolerance**: Some half-orcs have an increased tolerance for pain. They gain DR 1/— against nonlethal damage and receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects with the painUM descriptor. This racial talent replaces intimidating and orc ferocity.
